title: Spiced Pumpkin Pull-Apart Rolls
changes_from_base: Pumpkin purée, brown sugar and warm spices in the dough; 12 rolls in a round tin with an egg wash.
summary: Bright orange pull-apart rolls made with pumpkin purée, brown sugar and a little warm spice.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
cling film or a clean tea towel

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Put all the dough ingredients in a large bowl and mix, then knead 8-10 min, until soft and smooth. Pumpkin purée varies in wetness, so add a spoonful of flour if the dough is very sticky.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 60-75 min, until clearly puffy.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Grease the tin. Deflate the dough, divide it into 12 and roll each piece into a smooth ball. Set them in the tin, close together.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1 1/2 h, until the balls are crowded together and very soft. Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush with the egg wash and bake 22-26 min, laying foil loosely over the top for the last 5-10 min if they darken quickly; the centre roll reads 88-90 °C.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Brush with melted butter, leave 2 min, then turn out onto a rack.

tips: Pat very wet home-made purée dry with kitchen paper before weighing.
Tent with foil if they brown fast; the sugar and pumpkin colour quickly.
They are lovely with savoury dishes and with jam at breakfast.
storage: Keep cooled rolls in an airtight bag at room temperature for up to 2 days. Rewarm at 180 °C for 5 min; freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
